policy.vertex_matching: exact visible label identity; explicit code anchor; no spatial matching
policy.glyphs: small orthogonal paths supported by two longer body directions; protected labelled corners
policy.text_anchors: resolve visible label binding; presentation offsets are ignored; no nearest-point snap
policy.unused_coordinates: all unlabelled points excluded, including implicit crossings
policy.scope: drawn straight segments between labelled anchors; all supported labelled pairs, including composite segments
policy.ratios: one ordered ratio per unordered pair of incident segments, sorted by visible label
policy.duplicate_labels: same-anchor repeats deduplicated; conflicting anchors unresolved

audit.scope: label-bound straight segments; unlabelled crossings excluded
